basis: Existing authorization covers finding references, real image generation and acceptance. A visual preference is optional and is not a global prerequisite.
rules: Keep actual source identity/body/version; complete vehicle and accessories; real RGBA; source-compatible camera; no ground, cast shadow, reflection, background remnants or floating fragments; inspect on gray and dark backgrounds. Native tool resolution retained because no fixed RU canvas was supplied.
unverified_items: Keep exact model year, market-exclusive trim and unsupported configurations pending; isolate real evidence gaps without blocking other tasks.
historical_samples: Do not label an agent choice as user style approval. Explicit future user requirements supersede this working default with new SHA-bound revisions.
scope_clarification: Image acceptance establishes representative exterior applicability for the frozen generation/body/version record. It does not certify all scalar dimensions in the source library as physically correct. Keep numerical discrepancies in a separate data-quality audit without modifying frozen inputs. Explicitly different versions, market-exclusive geometry or unresolved body/generation remain separate and cannot be guessed.
reason: Task rules require identity/body/version, real image and SHA-bound visual acceptance; they do not require recertifying the upstream dimension library. Batch15 overextended an additional scalar-consistency check into a gate for four otherwise identified ordinary-body images.
numeric_variant_rule: Where numeric values encode multiple unresolved versions under one body label, preserve every requirement separately until exterior applicability is evidenced; first-generation paired Hatchback variants remain pending.
